effective_date_note: The fee in force for a month is taken from the most recent fee-tagged prospectus filing dated on or before that month's as-of date. Filing date stands in for effective date.

source.note: Before 22 December 2025 QQQ was a unit investment trust, whose prospectus states 'Annual Trust Ordinary Operating Expenses: 0.20% of the Trust's average net assets' in prose rather than a tagged fee table. The same figure appears in the 2025-01-27 prospectus. Tagged fee tables begin with the open-end fund's 485BPOS of 2025-12-19 (0.18%).
